source.inverse: Exact five-transform reversal restores the complete 2d9 preimage; original startup and tooltip reporters, outer catch/finally, later show calls and strict native assertions remain unchanged.

scope.initialRequest: Exactly one original first tron.window/show request promise; observeInitialWindowRequest is enabled only at the initial show call before the root-main mount check.

scope.conservativeDiagnosticOnlyLatch: Set when the watchdog callback fires while the request is pending, before directory reservation or preflight. A triggered resolving request raises E_STARTUP_DIAGNOSTIC_ONLY before remaining show assertions and before any passed report/tested archive.
scope.asynchronousOnlyWhilePending: This observation does not await its task or read/hash/report retained files until the original request settles. The sampler itself writes its fixed original file during sampling.
scope.ownerIdentity: Retained direct-spawn child object/PID/liveness before and after preflight, plus exact owned-PID/PPID/expected ps comm match. ps comm is argv[0], not an independent mapped-executable-path observation.

cleanup.lateClose: sample.closeObserved/closedAt reflect a later observed close; cleanupLimitReached remains historical. Task status need not change after task settlement.

scope.outputReservation: Async exclusive mkdir of the fixed startup-predeadline directory, mode 0700; an existing directory or failed reservation stops observation without overwriting prior sample evidence.
scope.observerEffect: Sampling can perturb scheduling. Every triggered run is diagnostic-only, including failed preflight. No launch timing or successful activation after attachment establishes native acceptance or a behavior correction.

evidence.observationJsonWriteMode: wx; collision or reporting errors stay secondary
evidence.identity: Exactly one valid matching Process header; optional Analysis-of-sampling PID declaration must be single, valid and match. Exactly one explicitly named serial main-thread group.
evidence.projectedFrames: Fixed image/function enums or unknown, safe integer count/depth and relative offsets only. No absolute addresses, arbitrary symbols, paths, raw stderr, ps command string, or application content.
evidence.hashScope: Whole sample SHA256 only after observed spawn/close, complete read within cap, successful file close, and stable fd/path file identity/stat checks. Incomplete or changing reads retain only a labeled capped prefix digest, null whole-file hash, and no frame projection. Failed reads/closes retain explicit unknowns.
evidence.overLimit: If the complete console envelope exceeds its cap, remove frame detail and record the omitted frame count; emit only when the resulting complete envelope fits.
evidence.originalErrorPreservation: Original request rejection identity is rethrown after bounded cleanup; observation, file and console failures cannot replace it.
evidence.requestedVersusMeasured: 2 seconds / 10 ms are requested sample parameters, not measured duration. Timer bounds do not prove OS termination; observed exit and close remain separate.
